summary: Full E2E test of Ruchio (Smart Kitchen Companion) — backend (2 endpoints) + frontend Expo web preview flow (onboarding → discover → pantry → recipe detail → saved → AI Chef → profile). All 3 backend pytest tests pass. All 11 UI flow checkpoints in the review request work as designed: onboarding wordmark + hero + stepper + Get started, basics (name/age/eating-style), avoid step (skipped), quiz step, Discover with HELLO/AARAV + Ruchio wordmark + SURPRISE ME hero + meal filter chips + empty-pantry callout + 9 recipe cards with match badges, Pantry with categorised chips (Proteins/Grains/Vegetables & Herbs/Dairy & Fats/Spices/Others) + search bar + Save pantry FAB + 'Pantry saved' toast, Discover re-computes CLOSE MATCH for saved pantry, recipe card opens detail, fav toggles, header heart opens Saved list with 1 saved item, AI Chef shows AI CHEF badge + hero + vibe chips + 5 pantry items + Non-Veg + Improvise a dish → LLM response renders Chef's Special result card, Profile shows Retake onboarding quiz. AI Chef backend call via Gemini 3 flash preview via Emergent LLM key works and returns AIRecipe with all required fields.

issues: Playwright inner_text scan did not find literal words 'Have' and 'Need' — labels may render slightly different (e.g. uppercase eyebrows or split copy). Not a functional bug; visually verify labels match spec ('Have' / 'Need') if you want exact copy.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — RN Web deprecation. Cosmetic only, does not break rendering.

action_items: Optional: replace legacy shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity style props with boxShadow to remove RN-Web deprecation warning.
Optional: verify recipe detail actually shows the words 'Have' and 'Need' as section labels (spec wording) — screenshot check may confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: LLM JSON parsing is defensive (code-fence stripping + json.loads with fallback) — good.
server.py: excludes MongoDB (no DB used in current server) — no _id serialization issue.
AsyncStorage on web maps to localStorage — onboarding persistence works; testing agents must clear storage between end-to-end runs (done in this iteration by running full flow in one session).

All interactive elements have testIDs; naming is consistent (onboarding-next, pantry-chip-*, pantry-save, recipe-card-*, fav-*, detail-*, ai-chef-generate/result/error, retake-onboarding, open-saved).
seed_data_creation: None. AI Chef uses live Emergent LLM key; test data (Aarav/28/Non-Veg pantry of 5 items) created only in in-browser localStorage during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All flows validated. If you rerun the UI script, do the whole onboarding→pantry→discover→detail→saved→ai-chef→profile in ONE browser session — AsyncStorage/localStorage resets per new browser context. Correct testIDs are onboarding-name-input / onboarding-age-input / onboarding-habit-<Non-Veg|Veg|Vegan|Jain> / onboarding-avoid-<i> / onboarding-quiz-<opt> / onboarding-next (used for both continue and finish). Recipe cards: recipe-card-<id>. Fav on card: fav-<id>. Detail: detail-back, detail-fav. Saved list: saved-item-<id>, saved-remove-<id>, saved-back. Discover header heart: open-saved. AI Chef: ai-chef-freeform, craving-<name>, ai-chef-generate, ai-chef-result, ai-chef-error. Profile: profile-name, profile-age, profile-habit-*, profile-avoid-*, toggle-avoid, retake-onboarding, stat-<label>.
